entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I need to start a return for an Aero Road Helmet I bought.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?
It's a preference thing. The color just wasn't what I expected when I saw it in person. It's a great helmet, I just don't love the shade.

I completely understand. Getting the aesthetics right is just as important as the performance. Our priority is your satisfaction and safety on the road. Can you confirm for me when you received the item?
Let's see... it was about five weeks ago. The box is unopened, still sealed and everything. I never even took it out.

Okay, thank you for that information. Let me pull up our policy. One moment... Yes, I see here that your helmet was delivered 38 days ago. You are well within our 90-day return window for standard items.
Oh, great. So it's no problem then?
No problem at all. I am generating a prepaid return label for you right now and sending it to the email we have on file. You'll receive a full refund once our warehouse processes the return.

That's good to hear. Now, since I'm going to be buying another helmet from you in a different color anyway, and I have to go through the process of shipping this one back, is there any way you could provide a small discount code for my next order?

I appreciate you asking, and I'm glad to hear you're sticking with VeloFit for your next purchase. However, our policy doesn't allow for goodwill discounts on preference-based returns. You will receive 100% of your original payment back, which you can then apply to the new order.
I see. Well, it was worth a shot. The full refund is fair. Thank you for your help.
You're very welcome. The email with the label should be in your inbox now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's all. Thanks again, Diana.
It was my pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
